import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p = params
    return p[0] + p[1]*np.log(1+t)**2 + p[2]*v + p[3]*v**2 + p[4]*v**3 + p[5]*t**2 + p[6]*x*v**3 + p[7]*x*v
